svg.title: What the mouse doses scale to in a 70 kg adult
svg.desc: Jabbit arithmetic using FDA body-surface-area scaling (mouse mg/kg divided by 12.3, times 70 kg). Doses posted on X in October 2026: 0.5 to 2 mg. Mouse high-fat-diet dose 0.5 mg/kg/day scales to about 2.8 mg; 5 mg/kg to about 28 mg; 15 mg/kg, the dose that improved running in old mice, to about 85 mg. CohBar gave its modified analog CB4211 at 25 mg a day. Mice were injected into the abdomen; people inject under the skin.
